original.question: What do WOG_OnCalculateMineIncome and WOG_OnCalculateMineIncome_Quit receive, and where do week, mithril, bonuses and handicap occur?
original.method: Ordinary bounded offline static PE disassembly and supplied ERM/Pascal inspection. REA unavailable, diagnosed previously; no REA Evidence record and no runtime observations. No installation or configuration.

observations.finding: Non-gold baseIncome is raw table amount, newIncome initially equal. Resource hook receives selected mine coordinates and amount before adding it to owner aggregate.
Gold baseIncome is read from immediate at0x4c7647 (default1000); wrapper checks owner/type, runs events, adds newIncome to local total, forces return0x4c764b skipping original add.

OnCalculateMineIncome runs first, then OnCalculateMineIncome_Quit with same coordinates and raw baseIncome plus the current mutable newIncome. Resource wrapper changes EAX if base differs; gold wrapper always manually adds final newIncome.
Mithril listener belongs to Quit, gated wog_36_enabled and map_rule_11_isEnabled=0. Any nonzero tile PO:N causes newIncome leftshift1. It does not double baseIncome or town/hero/artifact bonuses.

Resource week listener also belongs to Quit. If wog_20_double_mine_income and mine resource equals wog_20_week_subtype, current newIncome leftshift1. Week doubling is not already included in native baseIncome.
Non-gold pipeline: event-adjusted mine values summed, then other native resource contributions, then native AI resource adjustments, then owner handicap on each of six aggregated resource amounts.

Gold pipeline: sum adjusted gold mines; add towns/hero/artifact income; AI difficulty multiplier with integer conversion; owner handicap multiplier with integer conversion. Caller adds returned gold to total.
Conversion helper explicitly sets rounding mode bits to truncation toward zero for FISTP, then restores control word.

inferences.finding: If both listeners execute once and their gates match, each leftshifts current newIncome; combined ordinary finite result is four times the input to these listeners. Their mutual registration order is unnecessary for this product and is not established.
Applying mithril doubling before owner handicap follows native order. Applying the handicap independently to each mine can diverge from native aggregate conversion.

inferences.derivedExample: Two upgraded rare-resource mines yield2+2=4; with15% aggregate reduction, trunc(4-4*.15)=3. Per-mine trunc(2-2*.15) summed yields2. This is a derived ordinary-value example, not a game execution.
For a human player, one upgraded gold mine and a separate500gold artifact bonus give2000+500=2500 before15% handicap, then2125; artifact bonus itself is not mithril-doubled. Derived, not executed.

unknowns: Hook registration source is present and addresses match native instructions; erm_hooker.era was not found as a direct file under supplied reference tree. Hook installation/runtime success is not established.
Search of supplied ERM corpus found these two listeners plus stdlib callsites; not proof that every external mod, injected plugin or unprovided profile has no other income event handler.
Mutual event listener registration/execution order between42 and58 not reconstructed; earlier OnCalculate callbacks may change newIncome before both.
Complete native AI non-gold scheduling formula and semantic identities of all native town/hero contributions were not reconstructed; their later position is observed.
No execution and no full era.dll detour/injected plugin analysis; unexamined runtime patches could change native behavior.
No assertion about overflow, NaN, out-of-range x87 conversion, invalid owner handicap codes, or absent mine/resource records.
VCMI implementation not inspected here. Matching aggregate rounding and other packs requires separate engine checks.

regions.name: resource_mine_loop
regions.observation: Owned non-gold mines: EAX loaded from resource base table at 0x4b8863; hook 0x4b886a precedes addition into owner resource aggregate. No pre-hook week multiplier.

regions.name: resource_town_contributions
regions.observation: Town resource contributions follow mine loop.

regions.name: resource_artifact_hero_contributions
regions.observation: Artifact and hero resource contributions follow mine aggregation; gold calculation called at 0x4b8a9f and added at 0x4b8aac.

regions.name: resource_AI_adjustments
regions.observation: Native AI resource adjustments follow income contributions and precede handicap. Full scheduling formula not reconstructed.

regions.name: resource_aggregate_handicap
regions.observation: Loops six non-gold resource totals for eligible players, obtains player code from GameMgr+0x1f6a8+player and coefficient table 0x677998; computes total-total*coefficient, calls truncation helper.

regions.name: gold_mine_loop_and_hook
regions.observation: Initializes total, iterates mines. Hook 0x4c7637 before owner/type checks; native 0x4c7644 adds immediate1000 to local total. Next mine is0x4c764b.

regions.name: gold_town_hero_contributions
regions.observation: Town income helper0x5bfa00 and visiting hero income helper0x4e4600 add after mine loop.

regions.name: gold_artifact_contributions
regions.observation: Counts owned hero artifacts115/116/117 via0x4ba890 and adds1000/750/500 gold respectively after mine loop.

regions.name: gold_hero_contributions
regions.observation: Owned hero income helper0x4e4600 called and added after artifact income.

regions.name: gold_AI_multiplier
regions.observation: AI flag at player+0xe2; difficulty0/3/4 multiply accumulated gold by.75/1.25/1.50; other difficulty branches unchanged. Conversion helper truncates.

regions.name: gold_aggregate_handicap
regions.observation: Player code at GameMgr+0x1f6a8+player:1 multiplies total by.85,2 by.70, otherwise unchanged; truncation helper then return.

regions.name: truncation_helper
regions.observation: Saves x87 control word, ORs high byte with0x0c, loads changed word, FISTP qword, restores control word; returns integer low/high halves.

regions.name: gold_handicap_coefficients
regions.observation: Three doubles:.70,.85,1.25; last is AI difficulty coefficient.

nativeComparison.evidenceKind: Source inspection and arithmetic inference, not yet a native handicap scenario.
nativeComparison.remaining: VCMI currently applies owner income handicap separately to mine contributions; ERA aggregates modified mine income with other income before applying the handicap. Aggregate-rounding equivalence remains to port.
